models.algorithm: normalized token inverted index with bounded deterministic top-k insertion
models.expectedComplexity: O(total indexed terms) build; O(sum posting lengths plus k) query

models.algorithm: deterministic package grouping followed by capacity-aware existing-trip assignment
models.expectedComplexity: O(requests times candidate trips plus package groups times assigned trips)

models.algorithm: equirectangular point-to-polyline detour estimate with temperature, stop, mass, volume, and time gates
pro-rata package and disclosed trip compensation allocation with conservation checks

gates.unknownAvailability: excluded unless the user explicitly enables scenario-only unknown inventory
gates.temperature: reject an assignment when declared cold capacity or transit limit is exceeded
gates.privacy: only pseudonyms and neighborhood centroids enter simulation or presentation
gates.conservation: requested equals fulfilled plus unserved; purchased equals fulfilled plus waste
gates.nonconvergence: not applicable to deterministic bounded grouping; invalid inputs fail closed

value.reason: Algorithms are deterministic for declared inputs; demand, travel, inventory, and behavior are not empirically calibrated.

claimBoundary: The solver is a neighborhood-market simulation. It does not establish optimal citywide routing, real inventory, legal marketplace status, or food-safety compliance.
